notes.title: Teleportation Book Item further fixed
notes.content:
Hello.. again :D

The item "Teleportation Book" is not glitchy anymore.

Hope you enjoy the game now, with all old and new updates!

notes.title: End game scene little fix
notes.content:
Hello!

Only a minor thing about not be able to leave before last boss. Now you can restock if needed :)

notes.title: Minor fixes and some new art and wallpapers!
notes.content:
Helloooooo pretty you!

I have updated the Credits Image in game and also fixed some more minor typos and wall/tile clipping issues.

I also have found added some WALLPAPERS in the Steam game folder if you'd like to decorate your desktop with some groovy art!

ENJOY!https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzQ3NjA5MjUucG5n/original/GxNk%2Fk.png

notes.title: A new useful item can be found in game.
notes.content:
Hello real gamers!

This time a new item can be found.
A Teleportation Book! Makes the travelling back to town less time consuming.

But where can it be found? :P

notes.title: Upgrade your World Map!
notes.content:
Hey again!
A little bigger update now with new content to the game.
This time a new NPC is added which sells directions and tips for you to see on your World Map-item.

Find him. He is not hard to find!

His directions are well worth it.
8 directions to the dungeons and 2 major bonus Secrets!.

A whole new location added!

notes.title: Minor Fixes with Onion description and minor stuff
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Lotharusians or whatever we call us in Lotharus!?

A little help to understand how to get rid of poison have been added where you first met Saborilli.
And some other minor issues have been taken care of.

Enjoy!
